name: Camping Stubai
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Stubai is situated in Neustift in the Stubai Valley. The complex features parceled pitches tailored to various types of vehicles. The sanitary facilities meet the highest modern standards. A small supermarket and a restaurant are conveniently located on site. The Stubai Valley is a premier destination for mountain sports enthusiasts. In summer, countless hiking trails invite alpine adventures, while in winter, the nearby Stubai Glacier ski resort guarantees exceptional snow conditions.
